rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose way to say that a performer takes a leading role in a show.

example.traditional: 我哋今次喺套劇入面做主角。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 hai2 tou3 kek6 jap6 min6 zou6 zyu2 gok3

rows.note: Use this for a movie star or a famous celebrity rather than a celestial star or rating symbol.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 ming4 sing1

rows.note: Use this when stating that a particular performer is featured as a lead in a film or programme.

example.english: Andy Lau will star in this film.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau4 lau4 dak1 waa4 zyu2 jin2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a celestial or astronomical star when technical precision is unnecessary.

example.english: I saw a star in the sky tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚我喺天空見到一粒星。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 hai2 tin1 hung1 gin3 dou2 jat1 lap1 sing1

rows.note: Use this for marking text, an item, or a list entry with an asterisk.

example.english: When filling out the form, put a star in this box.
example.traditional: 填表嗰陣，呢格要打星號。
example.jyutping: tin4 biu2 go2 zan6 ni1 gaak3 jiu3 daa2 sing1 hou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a hotel, film, or other quality rating expressed in stars.

example.english: This hotel has a star rating of five.
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 jau5 ng5 sing1 kap1

rows.note: Use this for the asterisk or other star-shaped symbol, not for a star in the sky.

example.english: Fields marked with a star must be filled in.
example.traditional: 有星號嘅欄位一定要填。
example.jyutping: jau5 sing1 hou6 ge3 laan4 wai2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tin4
